summary: DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 23, 2026, reporting the repurchase of $471.8M principal of its 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 for ~$1.474B in privately negotiated transactions. The repurchase was funded by a concurrent registered direct offering of 12,543,915 shares at $117.54/share, net proceeds, and cash on hand. The company entered into share purchase agreements with the note holders. This structured capital return reduces debt and dilutes equity. Watch for any follow-on actions or leverage changes.
